sourceBinding.scopeMeaning: Only memoryProbe diagnostics changed in native/main.cjs. The measured frontend and built assets are identical to the 831 controller candidate qualified by 57 native checks; this is not a new graphics-matrix qualification.

summary.meaning: Observed process working-set sums include shared pages; not unique resident memory, VRAM, a budget or a leak-free conclusion.

limitations: Only the explicit soak diagnostics changed at 1f46e11; frontend/build hashes match the 57-check 831 native run.

The owned probe window was activated once during preflight after visible/unhidden/controller-active state alone produced no rendering. Actual frames, callbacks and visual clock advanced before the three-second warm-up. The reported 90.006-second probe window includes that warm-up and approximately 87 seconds of phase sampling. This intervention is recorded, not hidden.

Five intended-active phases passed visibility/active and real-render/clock validation. Passive Quiet/minimize counts include entry/reconciliation; they remain separate from warmed steady-state verifier windows.
Working-set sums may count shared pages repeatedly and measure neither unique resident memory nor VRAM.
A short probe with desktop load, Chromium allocation/cache changes and no forced GC cannot establish long-term leak freedom, thermal stability, energy use or production memory acceptance.
The failed unrendered 831 attempt and earlier valid 759 probe remain separate preserved evidence.
Private machine paths, process/window identifiers and raw logs are omitted; measured sample values and source/build binding remain.
